correctness.rationale: The 18-vertex LCF graph [5,7,-7,7,-7,-5]^3 is cubic. Exhaustive smallest-unmatched-vertex recursion yields exactly 42 perfect matchings: 36 whose complement is a single alternating 18-cycle and six whose complement is three hexagons. Each ordinary matching participates in one unlabelled factorization, each exceptional one in four, so 3|states|=36+6*4=60. The two triples of pairwise-disjoint exceptional matchings give two hub states, and six K4 switch cliques meet three-at-a-hub; total graph is 2[K1 join (3K3)], 20 states and 36 switching edges. Independent new Python matching/edge-coloring reconstruction confirms both ten-state components and degrees; this is exhaustive finite proof, not extrapolation.
residual_risks: Reproduces finite graph only; no claim about all cubic graphs or named-palette states.
